interface_driver.description: Interface driver used for L3 agent to manage virtual network interfaces

enable_ha.description: Enable high availability mode (HA) for routers (requires L3 HA support)

num_router_processes.description: Number of parallel processes handling router operations (for performance scaling)

router_delete_namespaces.description: Delete network namespaces when a router is removed (clean up resources)

max_floating_ips_per_router.description: Maximum number of floating IPs allowed per router

dvr_snat_default_snat_ip.description: SNAT IP for DVR SNAT namespaces (auto-computed if left empty)

dvr_mode.description: DVR (Distributed Virtual Routing) mode: legacy (no DVR), dvr (DVR), or dvr_snat (DVR + SNAT)

external_network_bridge.description: Name of the bridge used for external network connectivity

agent_alive_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between heartbeats to the Neutron server

agent_alive_threshold.description: Number of missed heartbeats before marking agent as dead

services.description: List of custom sections with arbitrary configuration overrides (for advanced tuning)

body.description: Raw INI content for the section (key=value pairs, one per line)

router_mode.description: Default router mode for new routers

snat_internal_bridge.description: Bridge used for SNAT internal traffic in DVR mode

use_namespaces.description: Use Linux network namespaces to isolate router instances

max_external_gw_nets.description: Maximum number of external networks a router can connect to (0 = unlimited)
